name: rebuilt-v4-default-replay

base_results.finding: post-reboot exact item251 replay; physical validator-4 still collapsed
packed topology removed physical validator-4 but under-delivered load

hypothesis: After item259 proved physical validator-4 was pathological and the host was OS-reinstalled, restoring the default four-host topology and replaying the exact item251 binary/config should recover item251-class throughput if the old host substrate was the dominant regression.

validator-4.host_note: OS reinstalled before this replay; SSH host key refreshed

pre_run_notes: Removed the stale SSH known_hosts entry for 203.0.113.16 after the OS reinstall and accepted the new host key.
Confirmed SSH root access to 203.0.113.16 after the user installed the local public key.
Stopped and disabled packed-topology leftovers: kombat-chain-v4 and kombat-chain-ingress4 through kombat-chain-ingress6.
Verified the default topology: one kombat-chain service and three ingress services per VPS.
Verified all four validators run sha256 dd02298286ef973ebc1eec24459cd58cdc80f7c5c5e97ffee48d52b5979881dd.
commands: curl kombat_getConsensusMetrics on all four validator RPC endpoints
curl kombat_getStateRootAtHeight(height=100) on all four validator RPC endpoints

cd chain/deploy/ansible && KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=$(grep -m1 '^KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=' /tmp/and-live-testnet/validator-1.env | cut -d= -f2-) KOMBAT_BINARY_PATH=/tmp/kombat_chain-live-dd022982 .venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventory/testnet.yml playbooks/verify.yml

result.classification: The rebuilt validator-4 host improves the default topology from the failed exact replays and packed workaround, while preserving correctness, but it does not recover item251-class green TPS. Endpoint delivery remains strongly skewed: validators 2/3 deliver about 7.4k RPS per ingress, while validator-1 and rebuilt validator-4 deliver only about 2.0k and 2.3k RPS per ingress.

decision.reason: The rebuilt validator-4 default topology is correct and materially better than the broken-host replays, but official committed TPS is still only 54,762.3, below the 76k green recovery floor and item251's 77,666.8 TPS. The remaining bottleneck is not consensus divergence; it is host/ingress delivery skew, with validators 1 and 4 under-delivering relative to validators 2 and 3.
decision.next_move: Recover green by controlling host roles and load delivery rather than protocol micro-tuning. Keep this exact result tagged, then run a codified topology/loadgen recovery slice that either removes weak ingress hosts from the driven set or adds dedicated external loadgen/ingress capacity while preserving the four-validator consensus set.

rollback: Default inventory/testnet.yml topology is active. The exact item251 binary remains deployed on all four hosts.
